title: C5 confirmatory selective structural execution with CASM-S
question: When the retained candidate set is reduced from H to K before structural execution, does the same CASM-S evaluator perform proportionally less measured structural work while preserving task capability?
hypothesis: For the controlled multi-valid equality benchmark, exact addressing should reduce the number of CASM-S graph executions from H to at most K without using hidden task truth in routing or addressing. The experiment measures actual CASM-S execution work associated with the retained set; it does not establish semantic retrieval, learned addressing, or general C5.

arms.name: exhaustive
arms.intervention: execute every H candidate structure through the CASM-S evaluator

arms.name: exact-indexed
arms.intervention: content-address the candidate universe and execute only the retained K candidates

arms.name: representation-addressed
arms.intervention: retain top-K candidates by fixed cosine similarity of public query bits and candidate descriptors

endpoints.name: success_rate
endpoints.description: Fraction of measured queries whose final selected action is acceptable under the hidden environment evaluator.

endpoints.name: structures_executed_per_query
endpoints.description: Number of retained structures submitted to CASM-S per measured query.

endpoints.name: candidate_edges_per_query
endpoints.description: Candidate edges presented to CASM-S across all executed retained structures per query.

endpoints.name: gate_evaluations_per_query
endpoints.description: Per-edge CASM-S gate evaluations across executed retained structures per query.

endpoints.name: executed_structural_operations_per_query
endpoints.description: Non-input CASM-S node operations executed per query.

endpoints.name: node_outputs_per_query
endpoints.description: Active CASM-S node outputs produced per query.

endpoints.name: casm_forward_batches
endpoints.description: Number of batched CASM-S forward calls over the measured query window.

endpoints.name: wall_clock_seconds
endpoints.description: Measured runtime of the C5 query window on the declared hardware.

decision_rule.condition: exact-indexed success_rate remains within the exhaustive arm seed spread while structures_executed_per_query is no greater than K
decision_rule.licenses: the tested exact selective-execution boundary preserves capability for this controlled benchmark and the measured CASM-S work follows the retained set
decision_rule.does_not_license: semantic retrieval, learned addressing, or the full system-level C5 claim

decision_rule.condition: exact-indexed success_rate is materially below exhaustive at the same H and K
decision_rule.licenses: capability loss is observed under the tested retained-set budget
decision_rule.does_not_license: that selective execution or cheap addressing is impossible

decision_rule.condition: structures_executed_per_query or CASM work fails to decrease with the retained set under otherwise matched conditions
decision_rule.licenses: the implementation does not expose the intended structural work reduction and requires audit before a C5 interpretation
decision_rule.does_not_license: a general statement about CASM-S efficiency

held_constant: CASM-S source commit is pinned to c31554413301e3c9d3e6b3f8c8c6be572a74a748
same CASM-S model instance and evaluator are used across all arms
same candidate population and task stream are used for matched seed and H cells
candidate validity is multiple-valid on two marked equality positions
no exhaustive fallback is permitted after an empty retained set
hidden target and acceptable_actions are used only after execution for evaluation
warmup queries are fixed at 3 and excluded from endpoint averages
CASM work is counted from the actual serialized graph submitted to the external model
